taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 398, Polemonium pulcherrimum: an erect perennial 1 dm to 3 dm high, tufted with age.

traits.life_span.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 398, Polemonium pulcherrimum: a perennial.

traits.rosette.note: A tuft of basal leaves under the flowering stems, set by hand from iNaturalist photos of flowering plants (observations 171139570, 101812673, 54017969, 125065662, 60925680, 70968981, 286980700, 282741175): the flora gives no count or measure.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: leaves 5 cm to 15 cm long; set from 4 cm, as the stem leaves are shorter.

traits.leaf_division.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 398, Polemonium pulcherrimum: leaves of 5 to 11 pairs of leaflets.

traits.division_pattern.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 398, Polemonium pulcherrimum: leaflets in pairs along the rachis: pinnate.

traits.division_order.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 398, Polemonium pulcherrimum: the leaflets entire, so the leaf is divided once.

traits.leaflets.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 398, Polemonium pulcherrimum: 5 to 11 pairs of leaflets; drawn as 7 pairs and a terminal one.

traits.terminal_leaflet.note: Each leaf ending in one leaflet, set by hand from iNaturalist photos of flowering plants (observations 171139570, 101812673, 54017969, 125065662, 60925680, 70968981, 286980700, 282741175): the flora gives no count or measure.

traits.leaflet_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 398, Polemonium pulcherrimum: leaflets 2 mm to 8 mm long.

traits.leaflet_width_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 398, Polemonium pulcherrimum: leaflets 1 mm to 5 mm broad.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 398, Polemonium pulcherrimum: leaflets ovate to round, blunt and entire.

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 398, Polemonium pulcherrimum: the flowers in a cyme on long slender pedicels.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: Five equal corolla lobes: a regular flower, set by hand from iNaturalist photos of flowering plants (observations 171139570, 101812673, 54017969, 125065662, 60925680, 70968981, 286980700, 282741175): the flora gives no count or measure.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 398, Polemonium pulcherrimum: corolla between rotate and bell-shaped.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 398, Polemonium pulcherrimum: corolla 5 mm to 8 mm long and as broad.

traits.flower_colour.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 398, Polemonium pulcherrimum: lobes blue, the tube yellowish; sRGB by eye from the photos.

traits.fruit_type.note: A capsule, as in the family (Abrams 1951): the species account does not describe its fruit.

traits.flowering_months.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 398, Polemonium pulcherrimum: flowering June to August.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: green stems and leaves, the leaflets small, oval and close-set along the rachis.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for showy Jacob's-ladder from Abrams's description and the photos the traits cite: the herb program's structure (stems, nodes, basal leaves, how the flowers are borne). Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 0.2 m tall at 3 years in the open, within the flora's range. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
